breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。

master.definition_en: An erythrokeratodermia variabilis caused by a variation in the KDSR gene, which impairs the sphingolipid pathway enzyme 3-ketodihydrosphingosine reductase. Affected individuals develop severe localized and acral hyperkeratotic, erythematous and scaly plaques, particularly on the face, genitals, hands and feet. Some individuals also exhibit thrombocytopenia or abnormal platelet production, reflecting the role of sphingolipid metabolism in megakaryocyte maturation.

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: the ending of pregnancy by removing a fetus or embryo before it can survive outside the uterus.
